display.purpose: PageHeader h1 — uma vez por tela.

components.name: Primary Button (Barber)
components.description: CTA principal barber dark. Ouro sobre fundo escuro.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C9A24A; color: #12100E; font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 20px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms, transform 150ms; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(194, 155, 64, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Primary Button (Beauty)
components.description: CTA principal beauty dark. Violeta sobre fundo escuro.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-beauty { background: #A78BFA; color: #17132A; font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 20px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms, transform 150ms; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary-beauty:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary-beauty:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Card (Outlined)
components.description: Card padrão. Glass-border inset, sem sombra em repouso.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-card, #1A1816); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, rgba(255,245,230,0.08)); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,245,230,0.12); transition: box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Chivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: var(--color-text, #F0EBE0); margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text-secondary, #A89A82); margin: 0; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(194,155,64,0.08), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,245,230,0.12); }

components.name: Input (Default)
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-input-bg); border: 1px solid var(--color-input-border); border-radius: 12px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-input-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-input-focus); }

narrative.overview: A bancada do profissional. Cada ferramenta no lugar certo, visível sem esforço. O AgendiX reflete o salão: quem está agendado, quanto faturou, se está no lucro. Sistema visual contido — accent só onde a ação acontece, superfícies neutras aquecidas, profundidade por glass-border.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Gray Rule
rules.body: Neutros aquecidos pelo accent do tema. Cinza puro proibido.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Accent em ≤10% da superfície por tela.

rules.name: The Glass-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards em repouso = tom + borda inset. Sombra é resposta a interação.

rules.name: The Hook Rule
rules.body: Sempre useBrutalTheme() — nunca isBeauty ternário em componentes.
